jamm_hud_set_font.reason: JAMM legacy draw-state wrapper forwards the font asset to draw_set_font.

object.reason: Catalog and boat array values resolve to the objects named by the adjacent catalog or boat fields.

disp.reason: Boat and lure shop display arrays resolve to matching boat icons and lure sprites.

PATH.reason: Fish movement assignments select existing paths passed to path_start.

dataobject.reason: Fish initialization selects the matching movement data object.

data_object.reason: Shop menus select the corresponding data controller object.

card_type.reason: Shop menus instantiate the selected card object.

body_sprite.reason: Composite fish rendering selects the matching body sprite.

face_sprite.reason: Composite fish rendering selects the matching face sprite.

tube_sprite.reason: Composite fish rendering selects the matching tube sprite.

harness_sprite.reason: Composite fish rendering selects the matching harness sprite.

main_sprite.reason: Rendering selects the matching primary sprite.

bg_sprite.reason: Parallax rendering selects the daylight background sprite.

bg_sprite_end.reason: Parallax rendering selects the daylight edge sprite.

bg_sprite_dark.reason: Parallax rendering selects the dark background sprite.

bg_sprite_dark_end.reason: Parallax rendering selects the dark edge sprite.

thund_sound.reason: Lightning sound arrays resolve to the corresponding thunder audio names.

gear.reason: Gear catalog array values resolve to the matching equipment objects; other scopes also use instance handles.

item.reason: Shop item arrays resolve to the matching tool and lure objects; other scopes use instance handles.

message.reason: Tool shop messages resolve to the corresponding notification objects.

set.reason: Lens overlay array selects the small, medium and large fish parent objects.

path.reason: Carver path helper objects select existing movement paths; lowercase path has other uses elsewhere.

target_index.reason: Companion fish select the corresponding partner object type.

escort_target.reason: Escort initialization selects one of the matching partner fish objects.

stick_target.reason: Attachment helper selects the swimming player object.

target.reason: These handlers select matching target object types; other target scopes also contain flags and instance handles.

potential.reason: Glutton selects a named prey object and reads its position through this handle.

fish_target_nearest_fish.reason: The helper passes its sole argument to instance_nearest and instance activation functions.
